name: set_title
about: Rename the deck. The title shows in the deck list and in the outline.

name: apply_theme
about: Switch the deck to a built-in theme (Light, Dark, Serif, Lecture, Minimal, Bold, Modern, Academic, Pitch, Dark Studio, Warm Paper). Slides keep their layouts and content and take the new colours, fonts and slot positions, fitted to the deck's page size; a logo set on the old theme carries over, and so do the layouts someone made (they go after the theme's own).

name.description: A built-in theme: `Light`, `Dark`, `Serif`, `Lecture`, `Minimal`, `Bold`, `Modern`, `Academic`, `Pitch`, `Dark Studio` or `Warm Paper`.

name: edit_theme
about: Change the deck's own theme with a JSON merge patch: colours (text1, text2, bg1, bg2, accent1 to accent6 as #rrggbb), fonts, text styles, dimmed opacity, or the layouts and master elements.

patch.description: A JSON merge patch on the theme: `{"colors": {"accent1": "#0b5cad"}, "fonts": {"heading": {"family": "Lato"}}}`. A key set to null is removed.

name: set_logo
about: Set the deck's logo, shown by themes that have a logo slot (Lecture has one top right). The image must already be in the image store.

src.description: An image in the host's image store, such as `assets/logo.png`; empty removes the logo.

name: set_present
about: Change how the whole deck presents. `slideNumbers` shows or hides the slide number the theme draws on every slide (a new deck has them off; a number a slide carries as its own text is not affected). `transition` ({kind: fade, slide or morph, duration?}) is how every slide arrives unless it names a transition of its own; kind none takes it away. Settings left out stay as they are.

input.title: SetPresent

slideNumbers.description: Whether the slide number the theme draws on every slide shows, in the editor, when presenting and in an exported file.

transition.description: How a slide that names no transition of its own arrives. A transition of kind `none` takes the deck's away, so each slide arrives with a plain cut again.

duration.description: Seconds; 0.6 for a morph when absent.

name: set_page_size
about: Change the size of the slides (page setup): a preset (16:9 is 960 by 540, 16:10 960 by 600, 4:3 960 by 720, 1:1 720 by 720) or a width and height in slide units (96 to an inch). Every slide, the theme's layouts and its master are refitted: boxes stretch with the slide, type follows the width, and pictures, turned elements and circles keep their shape. Going to another size and back can leave pictures a little smaller and positions a hundredth of a unit off.

input.title: SetPageSize
input.description:
Changes the size of every slide. Name a `preset` (`16:9`, `16:10`, `4:3` or `1:1`) or give
the width and the height in slide units.

preset.description: `16:9`, `16:10`, `4:3` or `1:1`. Left out when `w` and `h` are given.

name: add_slide
about: Add a slide. Pick a layout from the deck's theme and give text for its slots by role in Markdown; slots you leave out stay empty. Prefer one idea per slide and a layout that fits it.

about: Add whole slides that were made elsewhere, such as the ones of an imported PowerPoint file, after a slide or at the end. Each needs a layout the theme has. A slide keeps its id and its elements' ids unless they are taken.
